props.name: density
props.description: Particles per 10,000 square pixels of surface. 6 is roughly 90 in a wide panel.

props.name: speed
props.description: Pixels per second, before the per-particle jitter.

props.name: linked
props.description: Draw a line between particles that are close to each other.

props.name: pull
props.description: Radius in which the pointer pulls particles towards it. 0 turns it off.
